title: Crosswinds Boating Center

services.name: Kayak & SUP Rentals
services.desc: By popular demand we are now offering kayak and stand up paddle board (SUP) rentals on Jordan Lake. Our marina is the best place to rent kayaks in the Raleigh, Durham, and Chapel Hill area. We have both single and tandem kayaks and have an amazing and safe area for you to explore on Jordan Lake. Come experience

blurb: Crosswinds Boating Center is located just north of Highway 64 on Jordan Lake, providing easy water access for Raleigh, Durham, and Chapel Hill. They offer pontoon boat rentals, kayak and paddle board rentals, and have a convenience store on-site. The marina also features a public boat ramp, ethanol-free gas, and public restrooms.
